title: SNAPSHOT DATA badge is a permanent false alarm: shell summary never reads jobs

fix.shell_summary: ManagementService._shell_summary_jobs_read decides surfaces.running_jobs from the JobReadPort read diagnostics (healthy/degraded/configured sources); the dataset_source('jobs') lookup (always 'missing') is no longer consulted. ok->bff_composed ok; some failed/unconfigured/timeout->degraded bff_composed with degraded_sources; all configured failed->unavailable service_client with degraded_sources; none configured->unavailable missing.
fix.bounded_reads: Shell summary asks each source for one owner page (page_size 200, status in running/in_progress/queued); sources are read concurrently and the whole read is capped by PANTHEON_BFF_SHELL_SUMMARY_JOBS_BUDGET_SECONDS (default 1.5 s, capped by the management read budget); unfinished sources are reported as 'timeout'.
fix.cache: Process-wide shell summary count cache entry now carries a caller key (sha256 of authorization + selected tenant); another caller never receives it.
fix.owner: GET /api/source-ingest/jobs: status (comma list), page_size (1..250, default 100), page_token select a bounded form (newest first, receipts only for returned runs, page_info.total/next_page_token). Unbounded form unchanged. IngestStore.list_runs_page skips the full journal replay while the journal inode/size/mtime is unchanged.
fix.job_port: ports/job_read.py reads sources concurrently (copying the request context so caller authorization/tenant are preserved), uses the bounded ingest form and follows owner pages (page 250, cap 100 pages -> 'truncated' degraded marker), so /bff/jobs totals span all owner pages.

measurements_local.fixture: 9000 real IngestRun (5 events each) + IngestReceipt records written to the real journal; served by the real source_ingestion app (TestClient and uvicorn on a real socket)
measurements_local.note_latency: hosted measured 19.6 MB / 3.27 s unbounded; local fixture 19.8 MB. Bounded latency is dominated by the first journal replay; later pages in the same journal state skip it.

acceptance_map.4: same tests assert every emitted source in {bff_composed, service_client, service_store, bff_cheap_count}
acceptance_map.8: no existing test weakened or deleted; no existing assertion changed

existing_test_notes.test_execute_plans_final_live_wiring_con: fails identically on the unmodified HEAD (/bff/alerts empty); unrelated

limitations: Hosted behaviour not verified here; coordinator verifies.
Other job sources (worker gateway, orchestrator 354 KB, training, policy) have no bounded owner form; they are read in full, concurrently, and filtered client-side.
